title: Hensal House — Interior Design & Visualization

rooms.title: Entrance / sitout
rooms.intent: A quiet welcome: two compact timber seats, a warm wall light and a clear approach to the main door.
rooms.materials: Outdoor timber · warm-white paint · matte stone-look tile
rooms.check: Retain the 900 mm main door, adjacent window and three approach steps. Keep planting off the entry route.

rooms.title: Living room
rooms.intent: A compact straight sofa faces the retained stair-boundary TV. The centre remains open for everyday movement.
rooms.materials: Linen-look upholstery · oak · warm-white walls · pale porcelain
rooms.check: Retain the 1,800 × 730 mm sofa footprint. Avoid a central coffee table where it narrows the kitchen, stair or rear route.

rooms.title: Staircase / TV composition
rooms.intent: An upgraded feature composition with vertical fluted/slatted oak wood accents on the TV backing panel, integrated warm LED backlighting behind the screen, and a slim floating media shelf below. This keeps circulation open while preserving the under-stair wash and storage access behind.
rooms.materials: Vertical fluted oak slats · integrated warm LED backlighting (2700-3000K) · slim floating oak media shelf · charcoal metal · warm pale stair finish
rooms.check: TV centre remains at plan y = 4.125 m; screen centre +1.10 m. Fluted oak slats run vertically on the backing panel face. LED strip concealed behind TV edges for ambient glow. Floating shelf below TV holds media devices, max 200 mm deep. Stair route SOUTH → WEST → EAST; 2 + 7 + 8 risers and 900 mm flights. Under-stair wash and bifold storage remain accessible behind.

rooms.title: Under-stair storage
rooms.intent: Low headroom becomes useful household storage, with compact bifold access and reachable front shelves.
rooms.materials: Oak doors · washable greige lining · simple charcoal pulls
rooms.check: Crouch-in storage only. The existing R5 opening needs confirmation that the stair landing does not bear on this partition. Do not increase its height.

rooms.title: West-facing wash area
rooms.intent: A shallow hand-wash vanity and compact mirror occupy the upper-flight zone; the person stands to the east, facing west.
rooms.materials: Semi-recessed white basin · sealed oak · pale counter · charcoal tap
rooms.check: Standing zone 750 × 600 mm. Modelled clearance: 2.17 m at leaning strip, 2.35 m at body line, 2.53 m at rear. Keep the 400 mm cabinet-access strip for stoop access only.

rooms.title: Dining area
rooms.dimension: 1.45 m × 0.85 m rectangular table · six compact upholstered chairs
rooms.intent: A compact rectangular 6-seater dining table in natural oak seats the family comfortably while keeping the shared room visually open. A simple pendant defines the dining spot without a feature ceiling.
rooms.materials: Natural oak table · compact upholstered chairs · neutral seat pads · understated pendant
rooms.check: Retain the six-chair arrangement (three per long side). The table fits the dining bay without blocking the rear service passage. No crockery unit or sideboard must consume the central route or independent rear passage.

rooms.title: Kitchen
rooms.intent: An efficient L-shaped kitchen combines drawers, a short sink return and overhead storage on available solid wall.
rooms.materials: Oak base fronts · warm-white overheads · quiet greige counter
rooms.check: Clear room 2900 x 2050 mm. Retain WEST-wall 800 mm entry at plan x=2.10–2.90, y=2.20; east window/hob, short north sink return and southwest refrigerator. Coordinate extractor without deleting or blocking the window.

rooms.title: Bedroom 1
rooms.intent: A fitted ivory wardrobe with one muted oak bay and a 400 mm loft adds useful storage; the lift-up bed keeps the compact aisles free of side drawers.
rooms.materials: Matte ivory · muted oak · oatmeal linen · sage accents
rooms.check: Bed head stays south. Wardrobe 1500 × 550 mm; main height 2100 mm, loft top 2500 mm, open above. Six paired leaves at each level. Bedside aisles 625 mm; foot clearance 865 mm with parked slider. Preserve ensuite, room entrance, windows and private balcony route where applicable.

rooms.title: Ensuite 1
rooms.intent: Quiet warm tile and simple fittings make this compact bathroom easy to clean. The wet zone remains at the west end.
rooms.materials: Matte greige wall porcelain · textured floor tile · clear glass
rooms.check: Private pocket/sliding access from Bedroom 1. WC stays on the north wall; basin stays on the east wall. Preserve the existing west window.

rooms.title: Family / study
rooms.intent: Retain the approved three-machine tailoring function. Open the study/stair boundary and tuck a 750 × 450 mm linen/household cabinet against the side wall beside two compact workbenches.
rooms.materials: Natural linen · warm oak · muted olive · beige Roman blind
rooms.check: Retain the existing beam, stair flights and gallery/balcony boundary. The occupied-chair aisle is 650 mm; the stair connection is 2500 mm clear beside the cabinet. Main cupboard height 2100 mm, loft top 2500 mm, open above. Verify actual machines, chair movement, narrow tall-bay equipment fit and structural coordination.

rooms.title: Bedroom 2 / master
rooms.intent: A fitted ivory wardrobe with one muted oak bay and a 400 mm loft adds useful storage; the lift-up bed keeps the compact aisles free of side drawers.
rooms.materials: Matte ivory · muted oak · oatmeal linen · olive accents
rooms.check: Bed head stays south. Wardrobe 1500 × 550 mm; main height 2100 mm, loft top 2500 mm, open above. Six paired leaves at each level. Bedside aisles 625 mm; foot clearance 865 mm with parked slider. Preserve ensuite, room entrance, windows and private balcony route where applicable.

rooms.title: Bedroom 3 / L-shaped wardrobe
rooms.intent: A continuous 90° L wardrobe with ivory fronts, one muted oak bay and a 400 mm loft adds storage without a solid corner filler or cosmetic ceiling band.
rooms.materials: Matte ivory · muted oak accent bay · cream linen · muted clay · recessed charcoal pulls
rooms.check: Wardrobe depth 550 mm; main height 2100 mm, loft top 2500 mm. Front door run 1080 mm; overall return 705 mm, with 255 mm exposed face. Paired corner access without fixed face post. Clearances: 625 mm to wardrobe, 600 mm behind bed, 580 mm at foot; preserve the surface-sliding ensuite door. Final corner hinges and bed lift hardware require supplier detailing.

rooms.title: Ensuite 2
rooms.intent: A coherent continuation of the ground-floor bathroom, with practical wet-zone screening and restrained finishes.
rooms.materials: Warm greige porcelain · white sanitaryware · charcoal fittings
rooms.check: Stacked above Ensuite 1. Retain the master-side pocket/sliding entry and 650 × 500 mm rear vent. No new wall recess or plumbing relocation.

rooms.title: Ensuite 3
rooms.intent: A compact private bathroom for Bedroom 3, with the same cleanable material palette and generous attention to ventilation.
rooms.materials: Matte porcelain · textured floor · clear glass · simple metalwork
rooms.check: Retain east entry swing, west vent and north-side high window. Keep the basin on the east wall and WC on the north wall. Check shower access against the door swing.

rooms.title: Front balcony
rooms.intent: Two compact outdoor seats and a little greenery soften the balcony while the charcoal sweeping frame remains visible.
rooms.materials: Weather-resistant timber · glass guard · charcoal metal
rooms.check: Slider serves the common gallery. Keep its usable opening clear; do not introduce a bed or stair directly behind it. Use movable, light planting and retain the curved façade band.

rooms.title: First-Floor Passage
rooms.intent: An open gallery corridor connecting the landing to the study/family room and front gallery. No doors within the passage itself — it is an open walkway.
rooms.materials: Off-white walls · warm recessed lighting · restrained framed art/family photos in oak/black frames
rooms.check: Open passage with no doors. Runs from the stair landing (south) past the master ensuite pocket door toward the study/family room opening and front gallery. Do not add any swing or sliding doors to the passage corridor.

rooms.title: Front Gallery
rooms.dimension: Open area between study/family and front balcony
rooms.intent: A transitional gallery space connecting the study/family room to the front balcony through a sliding door, with a view toward the garden.
rooms.materials: Off-white walls · warm recessed lighting · oak accents
rooms.check: Open area accessed from the passage and study/family room. Sliding door (2.05 m wide) leads to front balcony (2.70 x 1.20 m). Keep the sliding door clear and the gallery visually open.

rooms.title: Roof terrace
rooms.dimension: Roof FFL +6.45 m · 2.20 × 4.10 m stair enclosure
rooms.intent: A small outdoor seating group leaves the terrace open for family use, circulation and maintenance.
rooms.materials: Outdoor porcelain · charcoal metal · timber-look cladding
rooms.check: Keep the north-side 900 mm exit swing clear, preserve both enclosure vents, drainage access and the southwest service reserve. No tank, pergola or structural planter is added.

palette: Sealed veneer on stable joinery; use timber only where exposure and maintenance suit it.
Washable wall finish; keep ceilings simple and bright.
Cabinet laminates, modest stone texture and bathroom wall tile.
Low-sheen porcelain indoors; tested slip-resistant finish in wet and outdoor areas.
Slim metalwork, pulls and light fittings, coordinated with the exterior.
Removable natural-look fabrics; sage, olive and clay used sparingly.
